## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] CI passes (Ruff, mypy, pytest as applicable)
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated
- [ ] Negative/error paths were considered

## Review

- [ ] Change is small and focused
- [ ] No direct-to-main development occurred
- [ ] Independent LLM review completed when required by `LLM_REVIEW_POLICY.md`
- [ ] Blocking review findings are resolved or explicitly accepted by the project owner

## Project Impact

- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior or architecture changed
- [ ] `DECISIONS.md` updated if a material decision changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, proprietary information, or generated media are included
